entries.c25b1896b4cc1f59: The medium-term management plan 2026 'ReRISE' sets out as basic strategies 'reorganization and new deployment of hotel brand categories,' 'value-up of the hotel business' and 'expansion of the new store opening pipeline.' Formulating 'RIHGA VISION 2035' as the target image for 2035, the year marking the 100th anniversary of hotel opening, and under the purpose 'Let us fill people, regions, Japan and the world with warm hearts,' it states it will advance growth strategies with the goal of expanding to 35 hotels as Rihga Royal Hotels by 2035.

entries.e446abf5de094413: Its main hotels are full-service city hotels with a balanced revenue mix across accommodation, banquet and restaurant divisions, and it has a customer base supported by a long history. Rihga Royal Hotel (Osaka) joined the IHG Hotels & Resorts collection brand 'Vignette Collection' and reopened after renovation, and the membership organization 'Rihga Members' surpassed 550,000 members in March 2026. Shiba Park Hotel Co., Ltd. has an inbound ratio of 95% of guests, with strength in visitors to Japan from North America, Europe and Australia, complementing the group's overseas sales.
